notes.title: Update
notes.content:
I have fixed several small bugs, added an intro video and updated the graphics on one room. Also fixed some bugs and added a small cutscene for the ending. 

Also i am slashing the price for the game in half permanently since i feel i didnt quite finish the game upon release. Hope you will enjoy this much improved version.

notes.title: Game Graphics update release 27/4 - 2020
notes.content:
I am updating the graphics in-game to all characters from 8-bit style to 16-bit style monkey island graphics. I also fixed a couple of small graphic bugs.

This will be done 27/4 -2020

Note: To get the update uninstall and then install the game again.
